result.title: Generative SDEs with Trainable Diffusion and Density-Based Losses
result.summary: We develop a divergence-kernel method for jointly optimizing neural SDE drift and diffusion fields and the initial Gaussian distribution, using losses that depend directly on the terminal density. In two- and eight-dimensional Gaussian-mixture experiments, we learn time-independent fields and obtain far fewer off-mode samples than score-based generators with similar parameter counts. The drift attracts samples toward the modes, while the diffusion helps disperse excess probability between them.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种 divergence-kernel 方法，用直接依赖终端密度的损失联合优化神经 SDE 的漂移场、扩散场和初始高斯分布；在 2 维与 8 维高斯混合实验中学习时间无关场，失模样本明显少于同等参数量的 score-based 生成器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“直接优化终端密度、考察模式覆盖”的训练目标，可能可供核查 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态生成中如何避免状态塌缩到少数模式；但实验限于低维高斯混合，与视觉推理尚无直接联系。
